# BoostPilot AI

BoostPilot AI is an AI-powered content optimization platform.

Features:
- AI image analysis
- AI video analysis
- Caption generation
- Hook generation
- Hashtag suggestions
- Platform optimization
- Technical quality analysis
- Export-ready reports
- YouTube thumbnail ideas
- Creator workflow tools

Platforms supported:
- YouTube
- Instagram
- Facebook
- LinkedIn

Website:
https://boostpilotai.vercel.app
